timeline.step: VPN login: the remote access appliance accepts a successful single-factor login for a valid clinical staff account from an unrecognised overseas address.
Detection: impossible-travel VPN session correlated with the unpatched appliance advisory and raised to P1 by the SOC.
Acknowledged: on-call analyst engaged the member within the P1 target and opened a bridge with Lakeshore IT Operations.
Lateral movement: the VPN session pivots over SMB to a file server using the same stolen credentials.
Credential dumping: an unsigned process reads LSASS memory on the file server, harvesting cached domain credentials.
Containment begins: the VPN account is disabled, the appliance session is terminated and the file server is isolated from the network.
Credential reset: every account exposed by the dump is force-reset and the attacker address is blocked at the perimeter.
Contained: no further authentication from the attacker infrastructure; containment confirmed 2h10m after detection.
Phishing campaign: 34 near-identical mails impersonating the payroll portal reach staff mailboxes from a look-alike domain.
Detection: the email gateway retro-scan flags the campaign and the SOC raises a P2.
Acknowledged: analyst confirms four staff submitted credentials to the harvesting page.
Containment: the campaign is purged from all mailboxes, the look-alike domain is blocked and the four accounts are reset with sessions revoked.
Contained: no successful sign-in from the harvesting infrastructure; awareness follow-up scheduled with the member.
Malware detected on a shared nursing-station workstation after a USB drive is mounted out of hours.
Detection: endpoint agent quarantines the payload and the SOC raises a P2.
Containment: workstation isolated, USB device blocked estate-wide and the account re-imaged.
Contained: no onward connection observed; removable-media policy raised as a finding.
Unapproved remote access tool installed on a diagnostic imaging workstation by a third-party engineer.
Detection: the SOC raises a P2 on the unsigned remote access binary.
Contained: tool removed, vendor session re-established through the approved jump host, change logged with the member.
Out-of-hours administrator logon to the theatre scheduling server from a non-standard workstation.
Detection: the SOC raises a P2 and the acknowledgement target is missed during the overnight handover.
Contained: logon confirmed as an unsanctioned maintenance window; shared administrator account retired in favour of named accounts.

advisories.action: Add impersonation rules for payroll senders at the mail gateway and brief staff on the look-alike domain pattern.
advisories.summary: A long-running phishing campaign is impersonating payroll and benefits portals at care providers, using look-alike domains registered days before each wave.
advisories.title: Credential-harvesting campaign targeting healthcare payroll portals

advisories.action: Block unknown removable media estate-wide and confirm endpoint agent coverage on shared workstations.
advisories.summary: Loader malware is being delivered on USB media left at shared nursing stations, then quarantined only where endpoint agents are current.
advisories.title: Ransomware operators abusing unmanaged removable media in care homes

advisories.action: Block unapproved remote-support binaries and route vendor sessions through the approved jump host.
advisories.summary: Third-party engineers are installing unapproved remote-support tools on diagnostic imaging workstations, bypassing the approved jump host.
advisories.title: Unsigned remote-support tooling used by imaging service engineers

advisories.action: Apply the vendor firmware update to every affected appliance, force-reset remote access credentials and review VPN authentication logs for sessions from unrecognised networks.
advisories.summary: A pre-authentication bypass in a widely deployed remote-access VPN appliance allows a valid-looking session to be established without the second factor. Exploitation has been observed against healthcare members running the affected firmware, and the three members below are confirmed to run it.
advisories.title: Authentication bypass in a remote-access VPN appliance (exploited in the wild)

advisories.action: Enable credential guard on file servers, alert on LSASS access by unsigned processes and force-reset any credentials cached on an affected host.
advisories.summary: Intrusions that begin at a compromised remote-access session are moving to file servers within the hour and dumping LSASS memory for cached domain credentials.
advisories.title: Credential dumping follow-on activity after remote-access compromise

advisories.action: Confirm every collector resumed after maintenance and alert on sources quiet for more than 72 hours.
advisories.summary: Clinical device and backup collectors are failing to restart after scheduled maintenance, leaving the member with no detection coverage on those sources.
advisories.title: Silent telemetry loss after clinical network maintenance windows
